QuestInfo.name: Truth of the Rumor-Blackbull
QuestInfo.0: Let's ask #b#p501##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p506##k lived in #b#m10004000##k for a long time. Let's go ask about the rumor.

0.0: That's all I know. Come to think of it... #b#p506##k may have mentioned something similar before. Why don't you go see her?

1.0: Hi, traveler. What brings you here today? How can I help you?\r\n#b#L0#Do you know anything about a ghost tree?#l
1.1: Oh, my! You also heard about the story? #p204# of #m10001000# said she saw the ghost on the way back to her home after visiting #m10004000# for her mom's errand.\r\n#b#L0#Are you serious?#l
1.2: Yes, she was going back to #m10001000# late at night. She stepped or tripped over a tree branch or something in the dark. She got scared and looked around, and you know what? She found a big eye staring at her as if it would eat her alive.\r\n#b#L0#That's terrible...#l
1.3: #p204# was terrified and simply passed out at that moment. After dawn, a number of adults went up there, but found nothing. It must be ghosts. What can we do? I don't think I can even get out of town. I'm too scared!

npc.0: Come to think of it... #b#p506##k may have mentioned something similar before. Why don't you go see her?
